description: Call duration of one capture-to-(1, 3, 640, 640) FP16 CUDA tensor call, per path, with a moving source. Medians across passes of 8 s per path. fps and call time are bounded by the source's update rate; CPU per frame is the column that compares. Every path verified before timing.
machine: Machine B, MUX hybrid: Intel UHD capture, RTX 4060 Laptop CUDA, 2560x1600 at 165 Hz

results.note: full BGRA upload; bilinear resize on CUDA
system-memory shared heap; no CPU pixel round trip
transfer_async + CPU-side fence wait
GpuConverter then TensorTransfer; the converted payload crosses, not the frame
GpuConverter only; requires capture and CUDA on one adapter
results.skipped: capture adapter has no CUDA device: no CUDA device is on the adapter holding this tensor (LUID d534010000000000); 1 CUDA device(s) present, none matching. This is the ordinary hybrid-laptop case: capture is on the integrated GPU. Transfer the frame to the CUDA adapter first.
